source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
As the battle begins, you can place this unit's Vox‑relay Beacon token at any point on the battlefield outside the deployment zone of your opponent.

While an **ASTRA MILITARUM REGIMENT** unit of yours is up to 6" from that token, your **OFFICER** units can issue [Orders](vsdata:ability/astra-militarum.voice-of-command) to it as if they were up to 6" from it.

As each phase ends, remove any Vox‑relay Beacon token of yours that has an enemy unit up to 1" from it.

detail.actor: Cadian Recon Squad with Vox-relay Beacon

setup.where: on battlefield outside opponent deployment zone

removeMarker.condition: an enemy unit is within 1" of the token
